§6Cadmium Steel§f

§aThe reliable swap for technetium steel. Same recipes, different farming chain.§f

§bCadmium Steel§f is cadmium alloyed with steel. It's a §efully interchangeable substitute§f for technetium steel in §ealmost all§f recipes, giving you a parallel path when technetium is scarce.

§6How to Make It§f (Blast Furnace or Crucible):
§b•§f §e1×§f Steel Ingot + §e1×§f Cadmium Nugget → §e1×§f Cadmium Steel Ingot

§6What It Replaces§f:
§b•§f §bReactor Remote Control Block§f
§b•§f §bModerated RBMK Fuel Rods§f
§b•§f §bGas Centrifuge Overclock Upgrade§f
§b•§f §bMagnetic Extractor§f
§b•§f §bReinforced Block of Niter§f
§b•§f All Technetium Steel recipes except a few edge cases

§6Two Paths§f: Technetium steel comes from waste reprocessing (passive, you get it as a byproduct). Cadmium steel requires active farming (mustard willow cultivation) but can be fully automated. Pick whichever suits your resource situation.

§ePS:§f Check JEI to confirm a specific recipe accepts cadmium steel before you commit to that path.
